description: Combine several PDFs into one, in the order given. Reads the local files, uploads them to the conv2pdf API, writes the merged PDF to output_path (or next to the first input) and deletes the conversion job afterwards.

output_path.description: Local path the merged PDF is written to. When omitted, merged.pdf is written next to the first input file. An existing file at this path is refused, never overwritten.

paths.description: Local paths of the PDFs to merge (2 to 20 files), combined in the order given. Each file is read locally and uploaded to the conv2pdf API.

name: merge_pdfs
